policyText: All disputes must be acknowledged within 1 business day. Dispute cases above USD 5000 require manager approval before creation. Credit memo creation always requires human approval.
Vendor invoice status inquiries for amounts above USD 10000 require human review confirmation before sending. Always include bank transfer reference in payment confirmation replies.
Payment arrangements above USD 5000 require human approval. Never threaten legal action autonomously. Escalate legal matters immediately to the Collections Manager.
Preferred partners receive priority handling. Acknowledge within 4 business hours. Include preferred partner language in all responses.
All email classifications with confidence score below 0.75 must be flagged for human review before any response is sent.
